How it works

From your first answers to your next refill, everything happens online. A provider licensed in your state reviews your history and decides what, if anything, to prescribe. You always know what you are paying and when.

  1. Consult
  2. Labs
  3. Plan
  4. Delivery
  5. Follow-up

  1. Consult

    Tell us about you

    Choose a program and complete a short online intake about your health and goals. A licensed provider reviews it, by video, by phone or by message.

  2. Labs

    Labs, if needed

    Some treatments call for lab results first. If yours does, your provider will tell you what is needed, and with your consent existing results can be added to your record.

  3. Plan

    Your plan

    Your provider decides whether a prescription is right for you, and at what dose. If it is not, they may suggest another option, and you are refunded in full.

  4. Delivery

    Sent to your door

    A licensed partner pharmacy fills your prescription and ships it to you. You get updates by text or email as it moves.

    Restore Vitality Health does not manufacture compounded medications. Actual product appearance and labeling of the medication you receive will differ from website images.

  5. Follow-up

    Ongoing care

    Your plan renews each billing period, with refill reminders by text or email. Manage your account in My portal, and cancel at any time.

Questions, answered

Who is Restore Vitality Health for?

Adults in midlife, men and women, who want prescription care for sexual health, menopause, weight or healthy aging, handled online. You must be at least 18 and live in the United States.

Where do you offer care?

In all 50 states and Washington DC. Some medications are not available in every state, and the intake tells you if that affects you.

How do I start?

Choose a program, or take the two-question quiz if you are not sure, then complete the online intake for the treatment you want.

Will I need a video visit?

Not always. Depending on your needs, your provider may review your intake by message, or ask to speak by phone or video.

Who is my provider?

A provider licensed in your state, who may be a physician, a nurse practitioner or a physician assistant, working with OpenLoop Healthcare Partners and its affiliated medical groups.

What are compounded medications?

Medications prepared by a licensed pharmacy for an individual patient. They are not FDA-approved, and the FDA does not review them for safety, effectiveness or quality. Compounding pharmacies are licensed and must follow state and federal rules.

What if I am not a fit?

Your provider may suggest a different option or a visit in person. If you are not a fit for medical reasons, you receive a full refund.

How will my medication arrive?

A licensed partner pharmacy prepares it and ships it to you, with updates by text or email.

How much does it cost?

From $96 every 4 weeks, depending on the treatment. Every price is on our Pricing page and shown again before you pay.

When am I charged?

When you complete your intake, for your first billing period. After that your plan renews automatically until you cancel.

How do I cancel?

Email support@rx.restorevitality.health or use your account, at least 72 hours before your next billing date. You keep your service until the end of the period you have paid for.

Can I get a refund?

Yes, in full, if a provider finds you are not a fit for medical reasons, or if you cancel within 72 hours of signing up and have not received any services. Medications cannot be returned once ordered.

Is my information private?

[HIPAA wording: pending client]. Your intake information is shared with your provider and pharmacy so they can care for you, and we do not sell your personal information.

Does the quiz save my answers?

No. The quiz only points you to a program. Nothing you choose is stored or sent.

How do I manage cookies?

Use Cookie settings in the footer at any time. You can also opt out of non-essential data sharing on our Do Not Sell page.
